_comment: AUTHORITATIVE protocol test vector for the RV sha256-legacy canonical form. RV receipts issued before migration 0278 (Ed25519 vault signing) carry signature_algorithm absent or 'sha256-legacy' and are signed over a 6-field form. The Go CLI (rvSha256LegacyCanonical in internal/dsr/canonical.go) must produce byte-identical output for this input. Distinguishing marker: signature_algorithm is absent (null in wire format).
_spec: rvSha256LegacyCanonical — v1-legacy / sha256-legacy: sort all keys by Unicode code-point order, JSON.stringify compact. Signature is SHA-256_hex(canonical_bytes). Mirror of the inline branch in receipt-verifier/index.ts:656-668.
_note_on_canonical_hex: canonical_sha256 is sha256(canonical_json encoded as UTF-8). The signature of a real receipt is SHA-256_hex(canonical_json) — the sha256 here IS the signature for this form.
